discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: Recent prizes went to AI (2024) and superconducting quantum circuits (2025), so condensed matter that is not quantum-information focused is due again. Topological insulators are a mature, much-cited field with a clear lineage: Kane and Mele's Z2 theory and Molenkamp's HgTe quantum-well experiment. Other contenders are metamaterials (Pendry), quantum cascade lasers (Capasso, Cho) and photonic crystals (Yablonovitch, John).
